requirement: A seat that keeps Tracy AI as Default can paste a picture: the seat-plan-tracy route reads what the deployment default reads

oracle.ref: PR #1235 (fix); fix evidence: Prod 12/10/2026 14:42: a seat with connections but Tracy AI as Default saw 'The current model does not support images'; an image that slipped through was projected to text before stream().
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. prepareCall('seat-plan-tracy', 'default') returns the deployment default's model info (inputModalities ['text','image'] for a vision default) with provider 'seat-plan-tracy' and id 'default'. With no deployment default, a default that is itself seat-plan-*, or a default dsh cannot describe, seat-plan-tracy declares ['text']. seat-plan-claude and seat-plan-glm still declare ['text']. A Tracy AI pin answered with fallback streams the deployment default with the original messages, image reference included.
